login.subtitle: One line under the 'CRM' wordmark on the sign-in page, saying what the page is for. The wordmark itself is a brand token, not copy. Polish may use the reflexive 'Zaloguj się' — it is the one sanctioned exception to the impersonal rule.
login.email: Label of the email field. 1 word.
login.emailPlaceholder: Placeholder in the email field — an example address, not a real one. Keep the reserved example.com domain and localize only the name part. The @ MUST be written as {'@'}: a bare @ is vue-i18n's linked-message syntax and fails to compile. The password field's •••••••• placeholder is decoration and stays in markup.
login.password: Label of the password field. 1 word.
login.submit: The form's submit button. Imperative, ≤3 words.
login.submitting: Label that button shows while the credentials are being checked. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words — it must fit the same button.
login.sso: Secondary button that starts suite SSO (OIDC via Control Plane). Imperative, ≤5 words.
login.ssoSubmitting: SSO button label while redirecting to the IdP. Ends with an ellipsis. ≤2 words.
login.orPassword: Divider copy between the SSO button and the email/password form. Lowercase ok. ≤8 words.
login.errors.failed: Shown in the error panel when signing in failed and the server gave no message of its own. Says what happened and what to do; no apology, and it must not hint at which of the two fields was wrong. This page renders before any session exists, so nothing here may depend on the signed-in user.
login.errors.ssoFailed: Shown when starting SSO failed before leaving the page (network / IdP unavailable). No apology.
oidc.callbackTitle: Subtitle under CRM wordmark on the OIDC return page.
oidc.completing: Status line while exchanging the authorization code. Ends with ellipsis.
oidc.backToLogin: Link/button back to /login after SSO failure. ≤4 words.
oidc.errors.missingParams: Callback URL lacked code or state.
